Title: Literacy: Comprehending texts - Level 1a
Description: Use behaviours that are not intentionally directed at another person to: Attend to, respond to or show interest in familiar people, texts, events and activities.

Title: Literacy: Comprehending texts - Level 1b
Description: Use informal behaviours that show consistent anticipation of events in regular routines to: Attend consistently to familiar texts; Respond consistently to social inteactions with familiar people; Demonstrate anticipation of predictable events; Respond to questions; Respond to requests.

Title: Literacy: Comprehending texts - Level 1c
Description: Use conventional behaviours and/or concrete symbols consistently in an increasing range of environments and with familiar and unfamiliar people to: Respond to a sequence of gestures, objects, photographs and/or pictographs; Respond to texts with familiar structures; Respond to requests.

Title: Literacy: Comprehending texts - Level 1d
Description: Use conventional behaviours and/ or abstract symbols consistently in different contexts and with different people to: Work out the meaning of texts with familiar structures, such as illustrated books, printed word, Braille texts and pictographs, using knowledge of context and vocabulary; Respond to questions seuqence events and identify information from texts with familiar structures; Use information in texts to explore a topic.

Title: Literacy: Navigate, read and view learning area texts - Level 6

Title: Literacy: Listen and respond to learning area texts - Level 2
Description: Listen to two or more step instructions for undertaking learning tasks, listen for information about topics being learned in spoken and audio texts and respond to texts read aloud.

Title: Literacy: Listen and respond to learning area texts - Level 3
Description: Listen to spoken instructions with some detail for undertaking learning area tasks, listen to identify key information in spoken and multimodal texts and respond to texts read aloud.

Description: Listen to detailed spoken instructions for undertaking learning tasks, listen to spoken and audio texts, and respond to and interpret information and opinions presented.

Title: Literacy: Listen and respond to learning area texts - Level 5

Title: Literacy: Listen and respond to learning area texts - Level 6

Description: Use 12- and 24- hour systems within a multiple time zone to solve time problems, use large and small timescales in complex contexts and place historical and scientific events on an extended time scale.
